minor.issue: Cloudflare CDN rewrites Cache-Control to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' (CF-Cache-Status: DYNAMIC), overriding the backend's 'public, max-age=86400, immutable'. ETag/304 still works so browser conditional caching is unaffected, but CDN edge caching does not kick in. Origin behavior is correct; consider CF Page Rules to allow public caching for /api/image/*.

critical_code_review_comments: watchdog_service.py:186 — run_health_checks pops the 5xx error counter EVERY time it is called with remediate=True. The admin 'Run check now' button hits check-now with remediate=True, which resets the counter — so admins clicking it will always see errors count '0 server error(s) since last check'. That is arguably the intended semantics (a manual check IS 'the last check'), but the loop cadence (120s) and the manual button share the same counter, so a manual check can hide a real error spike from the next scheduled cycle. Consider decoupling manual checks from the counter reset.

watchdog_service.py:222 — the 'log non-remediated warnings' branch is gated on 'not actions' which suppresses ordinary warning-level incidents whenever ANY remediation ran that cycle. This can silently drop unrelated warnings (e.g. data_integrity) when the watchdog also relaunched a stalled batch. Consider logging each probe independently.

object_storage.py — put_object / get_object are blocking `requests` calls. image_service wraps them in asyncio.to_thread on the hot path (good), but any future direct caller in an async context could accidentally block the event loop. Consider marking these functions as sync-only in a docstring or providing an async wrapper.

server.py:2779 — Cache-Control 'public, max-age=86400, immutable' is being overridden by Cloudflare (CF-Cache-Status: DYNAMIC). Add 'CDN-Cache-Control' and 'Cloudflare-CDN-Cache-Control' headers, or a page rule, to actually get edge caching for the 2151 immutable image bytes.
